research: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1853728/goofs?tab=gf — the finale gag: the sister is struck from above and to one side, yet she is thrown straight backwards through the doorway into the next room. The joke is the physics being wrong: direction and distance out of all proportion to the cause.

https://moviemistakes.com/film9488/page3 — she flies straight back into the other room, and a rip line on her dress is visible. It is a wire yank: her body goes back-first, rigid and instant, and leaves the frame. That is the move to copy; no gun needed.

https://nevadafilm.com/production-notes-ratchet-pulls/amp — ratchet pulls use cables and a harness to make a performer look thrown through the air, which is the standard way to film people being hit by blasts or shots. Write 'yanked backwards as if by a rope at the waist' and the model gets a ratchet pull.
https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Undercrank — undercranking (filming slow, playing at normal speed) makes action zany and fast, a staple of silent comedy. The edit can speed the launch up.

https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/ultimate-prompting-guide-for-veo-3-1 — Google's formula: cinematography + subject + action + context + style. Timestamp prompting ([00:00-00:02] ...) assigns one action to each time segment, which we use to pin the fling to the first second and the hold to the rest. Phrase things as what should be present, not as bans.

https://www.imaginary.app/blog/runway-gen-4-slow-mo-complaints-veo3gen-11-motion-readability-fixes-when-your-cl — slow-mo comes from missing motion evidence. Fixes: countable beats with a rough duration, a hard push-off, contact and surface reactions (the car bouncing on its springs), a locked camera, words like 'cinematic/smooth/gliding' swapped out, and a still hold at the end to cut on.
https://framia.converge.ai/page/en-US/blog/ai-video-generator-prompts-motion-mistakes — give each action a time span; on Veo, start the action sentence with the verb or the motion.
https://ltx.io/blog/how-to-fix-slow-motion-in-ai-generated-video — when a model is unsure it slows everything down, so state one tempo and never mix 'fast' with slow-motion words.

https://www.veo3gen.app/blog/ai-video-looks-great-but-feels-off-a-creators-checklist-to-fix-unreal-motion-wei — have some things move a lot and others barely at all. Here the lad moves hugely and the figure is frozen.
notes: 1) Take the start frame from the NEW still, not CA2-a: in CA2-a the lad has no distance left to fly. 2) In every staging he flies BACK-FIRST, with his back to the door from the first frame, so he has no reason to turn round. Keep his back to the door in the still. 3) Edit: use only the first ~1.5-2 s of the clip. If Omni still stretches the flight, speed-ramp only the launch frames to 300-500% (undercrank feel), add 2-3 frames of directional blur along the flight path, and hold the bounce. Cut to the end card about 10-15 frames after the car settles, not at 8 s. 4) Sound does the impact: a quick whoosh, a soft upholstery thump, a squeak from the suspension. Staging C adds the door slamming. 5) The motion prompts avoid kick/hit/shoot/blast/push/strike. If a still with a raised leg (B) is refused, use A or C, where the figure's gesture is a hand or a fingertip. 6) If the figure turns to camera anyway, cut before it turns. Every motion prompt keeps the figure frozen in profile. 7) Omni may ignore the timestamp brackets; they are cheap to keep. If it reads them as text cues, drop them and keep the sentences.

stagings.idea: The doorway yank: the finale gag done straight. Side-on to everything, the lad sways two steps clear of the open door with his back to it. The figure, in strict profile, flicks out a flat gloved hand without touching him, and he is ripped backwards through the doorway as if a rope at his waist was yanked. All the comedy is in how much he moves compared with how little the figure does.

Camera at chest height on the pavement, side-on to the scene. The silver taxi fills the right of frame with its rear door swung wide open, a plain TAXI roof sign lit. The young man in the white shirt stands two steps left of the open door with his back to it, swaying, car keys raised, mouth open mid-word, smug grin. The figure in the lab coat stands at frame left in strict profile, one gloved hand flicked out flat toward his chest, not touching him, perfectly still. Thanks.
stagings.motion: Locked-off camera, real-time speed. [00:00-00:01] Snapping backwards as if yanked by a rope at his waist, the young man in the white shirt leaves the pavement stiff and straight, flies back-first through the open door and is gone inside in a quarter of a second, keys flying. The taxi lurches and bounces hard on its springs. [00:01-00:08] Everything holds. The figure in the lab coat stays frozen in profile, hand still out. Thanks.

stagings.idea: The follow-through freeze: start the clip already in mid-flight. The figure, side-on, holds a ridiculous ballet-high leg extension like a finished pose; the lad is airborne a metre from the door, flat as a plank, back-first, his keys hanging in the air where he stood. The clip only has to finish a flight that has begun, so there is no wind-up for the model to slow down, and the gag is the keys dropping after he is gone.

Low camera at the kerb, side-on. The silver taxi on the right with its rear door wide open, the plain TAXI roof sign glowing. The young man in the white shirt is caught in mid-air a metre from the open door, flat and horizontal, travelling back-first toward it, limbs trailing, face blank with surprise. His keys hang in the air where he stood. The figure in the lab coat stands at frame left in strict profile, holding one leg raised straight out at hip height like a calm dancer. Thanks.
stagings.motion: Locked-off camera, real-time speed. [00:00-00:01] Finishing his flight in a split second, the young man in the white shirt shoots back-first through the open door and vanishes inside; the taxi rocks hard on its suspension. His car keys hang in the air for a beat, then drop to the pavement with a clink. [00:01-00:08] Stillness. The figure in the lab coat stays in profile and lowers the raised leg slowly, then stands still. Thanks.

stagings.idea: The fingertip boop, a deadpan wide. A low wide frame, symmetrical and still as a sitcom set. The figure in profile reaches out one gloved fingertip to the lad's forehead. One touch and he is sucked back through the open door, the door swings shut by itself, and the roof sign wobbles. The figure blows on the fingertip like a gunslinger blowing smoke from a barrel: the old-western nod without any weapon.

The door swings shut by itself with a thud, the taxi bounces and the roof sign wobbles. [00:01-00:08] The figure, still in profile, blows on the fingertip once and holds. Thanks.
